chunks: And Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
If a bondwoman is raped and her virginity is taken, then one-tenth of her value is upon him; and if she is a free woman, then the dowry is upon him.

key_terms.اغْتُصِبَتْ: was raped or sexually violated by force

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due if a bondwoman or a free woman is raped and her virginity is taken?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning compensation in a case of sexual assault resulting in loss of virginity. It distinguishes between a bondwoman and a free woman, assigning financial liability according to their legal status in the ruling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4465 - Talhah ibn Zayd narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that Ali (as) said:
"If a bondwoman is raped and her virginity is taken, the perpetrator must pay one-tenth of her value. However, if she is a free woman, he must pay the dowry."
